remarks: Located in a 2-family zone, this home currently offers 2 separate levels of living spaces. On the first floor you'll find a sunny Living Room, Dining Room, Kitchen, Bedroom, Full Bath with walk-in shower and side porch. The second floor has: a small living area, small kitchen + bedroom. The deep corner property has a detached 2-car garage and additional parking on the private driveway. This home is in need of much TLC - but well worth the effort as it is located in popular Glenbrook, walking distance to the Metro-North Train Station, elementary school and neighborhood shopping + restaurants. This property is located in R6 zone and tax records list 6534 square feet which means it could become a legal 2-family. Buyers encouraged to perform their due diligence. Property being sold "as is". No disclosures available.
